"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since President Bush signed the No Child Left Behind Act into law, all states have developed an accountability plan of assessments, graduation rates, and other key indicators of student achievement for all individual students and groups of students.",

"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Every child must be able to read by the end of the third grade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Reading First initiative brings scientifically based reading instruction, including phonics, to children in the early grades.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Over $1.4 billion in funding for reading programs provides training for teachers and materials for children.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"States have received additional funds for early childhood reading efforts since the passage of the No Child Left Behind Act.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
